title: Warranty Coverage Owner Discount on a Prorated Glass Share
content:
**Clause.** For an owner accepting a prorated sealed glass replacement under Warranty Coverage:

- for an owner who holds an **active CareLine plan whose waiting period had ended by the acceptance date**, the owner discount is **that plan's parts discount**;
- for any other owner whose covered contract was signed under a **discount program**, it is **that contract series' rate for the program**;
- for every other owner there is no owner discount.

## Where each part is read

| Item | Record |
|---|---|
| CareLine plan, its status, enrolled date, waiting period and parts discount | CareLine Service Plans records |
| Discount program and the series' rate for it, window coverage | Window Replacement Contracts record of the covered contract |
| Discount program and the series' rate for it, door coverage | Entry & Patio Door Contracts record of the covered contract |

A **CareLine plan** is any plan of the CareLine Service Plans other than the On-Call Service Account. The waiting period had ended by the acceptance date when the acceptance falls after the last day of the plan's waiting period, counted from its enrolled date.

## Combinations

| Active CareLine plan past its waiting period on the acceptance date | Covered contract signed under a discount program | Owner discount |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | the CareLine plan's parts discount |
| yes | no | the CareLine plan's parts discount |
| no | yes | the series' rate for that program |
| no | no | none |

## Cases (hypothetical rates)

- CareLine plan with a 17 percent parts discount, contract signed under the senior program at 6 percent: 17 percent.
- CareLine plan still inside its waiting period, contract signed under the military program at 12 percent: 12 percent.
- On-Call Service Account only, no discount program: none.
